message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the **long‑weekend public holidays** in Canada for 2023.  
(These are the dates that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend. Some holidays are federal; others are provincial/territorial and may vary by region.)

| Date (2023) | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|-------------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Federal |
| **January 2** | Monday | New Year’s Day (observed) | Federal (when New Year’s Day falls on Sunday) |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Provincial |
| **March 17** | Friday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Provincial |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | Federal & all provinces |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | Federal & all provinces |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia, Yukon) | Provincial |
| **July 1** | Thursday | Canada Day | Federal |
| **July 3** | Monday | Canada Day (observed) | Federal (when Canada Day falls on Thursday) |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Federal & all provinces |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving Day | Federal & all provinces |
| **November 7** | Friday | Remembrance Day (observed) | Federal (when Remembrance Day falls on Saturday) |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Federal |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Federal |

### How to use this list
- **Long weekends**: Any holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday automatically gives you a three‑day weekend.  
- **Observed holidays**: If a holiday falls on a weekend, the following Monday (or preceding Friday) is often observed as a holiday.  
- **Regional variations**: Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario; National Indigenous Peoples Day in BC and Yukon). If your app targets a specific province, add those dates accordingly.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning logic, and let me know if you need provincial‑specific long weekends or anything else!
